descriptionPlain: Example Advisory is hiring a Business Intelligence Analyst to build dashboards and reporting for finance clients. You will partner with stakeholders to turn data into decisions.

lists.content:
• Build Power BI dashboards and data models
  • Write SQL against the data warehouse
  • Automate ETL pipelines with Python

• 2+ years in business intelligence or analytics
  • Strong SQL and Power BI skills

additionalPlain: Example Advisory is an equal opportunity employer.
